user_question: Count the hospitals located within each census tract in Centre County.

workflow_plan.goal: Count the hospitals located within each census tract in Centre County.

workflow_steps.title: Reproject hospitals to tract CRS
workflow_steps.purpose: Transform hospital point geometries from EPSG:4326 to the census tracts' EPSG:26918 CRS so the spatial count can use compatible coordinate reference systems.
workflow_steps.instructions: Reproject the input hospital vector layer to EPSG:26918 and preserve its point features and attributes.

workflow_steps.title: Count hospitals within census tracts
workflow_steps.purpose: Compute the number of reprojected hospital points located within each census tract polygon.
workflow_steps.instructions: Count hospital points from hospitals_utm18 within the polygons in input_2, retaining the tract features and adding a hospital count field.
